mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters signals a strong demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the GDP is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 1% in a month indicates supply chain disruptions, which can lead to reduced output and higher costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts and retail sales signals a strong consumer demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where both housing starts and retail sales are increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate combined with an increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased consumer spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases & PAYEMS increases in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the consumer price index combined with a rise in the federal funds rate indicates inflationary pressure and tightening monetary policy, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases & FEDFUNDS rises in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent increase in retail sales over three consecutive months signals a strong consumer demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.
